note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Covering a surface too early can trap moisture. Reinstatement waits for the confirmed trend.
Drying is tracked as a trend and interpreted by a competent person, not judged from one look or one number.

practicalCriteria: The learner tracks drying as a trend, with the method recorded for each reading.
The learner holds reinstatement while moisture is unresolved.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Moisture is still unresolved and reinstatement is proposed.
A pass figure is set without a competent professional.
